questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(125, 2, 3)

(512, 5, 3)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number + 3rd number)3 = 1st number.

Now,

For, (125, 2, 3)

⇒ (2 + 3)3

⇒ 53 = 125.

For, (512, 5, 3)

⇒ (5 + 3)3

⇒ 83 = 512.

Similarly, for **(1000, 7, 3)**

**⇒ (7 + 3)3**

**⇒ 103 = 1000.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25
questions.solution:
Given equation: 11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) - and +

Given: 11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 11 + __**2 × 16**__ - 19 = 25

⇒ __**11 + 32**__ - 19 = 25

⇒ __**43 - 19**__ = 25

⇒ 24 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) = and +

Given: 11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 11 - __**2 × 16**__ = __**19 +**____** 25**__

⇒ __**11 - **32__ = 44

⇒ -21 ≠ 44

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) - and ×**

Given: 11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ __**11 × 2**__ - 16 + 19 = 25

⇒ __**22**__ - 16 __**+ 19**__ = 25

⇒ __41____ - 16__ = 25

⇒ **25 = 25**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 4) × and +

Given: 11 - 2 × 16 + 19 = 25

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 11 - 2 + __**16 × 19**__ = 25

⇒ __**11**__ - 2 __**+ 304**__ = 25

⇒ __315** - 2**__ = 25

⇒ 313 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Newspaper : Editor :: Design : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The second word is the professional who is typically responsible for creating the first word.**

Here,

Newspaper : Editor → An editor is typically responsible for creating a newspaper.

Similarly,

Design : ? → An architect is typically responsible for creating a design.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Architect"**.

questions.question:
By interchanging which two numbers the equation will be correct?

9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1
questions.solution:
Given equation: 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 8 and 9

Given: 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**8 × 3 ÷ 6**__ + 4 - 9 = 1

⇒ __**4 + **____**4**__ - 9 = 1

⇒ __8 - 9__ = 1

⇒ -1 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 3 and 6

Given: 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 9 × __**6 ÷ 3**__ + 4 - 8 = 1

⇒ __**9 × **__**__2__** + 4 - 8 = 1

⇒ __**18 **____**+ 4**__ - 8 = 1

⇒ __22 -____ 8__ = 1

⇒ 14 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) 3 and 4**

Given: 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**9 × 4 ÷ 6**__ + 3 - 8 = 1

⇒ __**6 + 3**__ - 8 = 1

⇒ __9____ - 8__ = 1

⇒ **1 = 1**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 4) 6 and 8

Given: 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 4 - 8 = 1

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**9 × 3 ÷ 8**__ + 4 - 6 = 1

⇒ __**3.375 **____**+ 4**__ - 6 = 1

⇒ __7.375 - 6__ = 1

⇒ 1.375 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Capacities of six tanks A, B, C, D, E and F are compared. No two tanks have same capacity. Capacity of D is more than F and C. Capacity of A is less than only B. Which of the following sequence about their capacities can be correct?

I. A > D > E

II. C > F > E
questions.solution:
Given: Six tanks A, B, C, D, E and F are compared. 

No two tanks have same capacity. 

The capacity of D is more than F and C. 

D > F > C

or 

D > C > F

The capacity of A is less than only B.

B > A > __ > __ > __ > __

After combining the statements, we have 8 possible cases;

Case I: B > A > D > F > C > E

Case II: B > A > D > C > F > E

Case III: B > A > E > D > C > F 

Case IV: B > A > E > D > F > C

Case V: B > A > D > F > E > C

Case VI: B > A > D > C > E > F

Case VII: B > A > D > E > C > F 

Case VIII: B > A > D > E > F > C

Now, checking the given sequence:

I. A > D > E - True (From case I)

II. C > F > E - True (From Case II)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (4)**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__

We have reviewed the question and found it to be correct. The task is to determine whether the given sequence is "POSSIBLE" or not.

After considering all possibilities, we conclude that both sequences are possible. This means that both sequences can occur, but neither is definitely true.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All P are G.

II. Some F are P.

**Conclusion:**

I. All G are P.

II. All P are F.

III. Some F are not G.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. All P are G.

II. Some F are P.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e5a0caba45905c5a6b890d6a410163a8e7640753a77638e6da79a4548dfff1b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All G are P - False (Because, All P are G gives some G are P, but all G are P can be possible only).

II. All P are F - False (Because, Some F are P gives some P are F, but all P are F can be possible only).

III. Some F are not G - False (Because, Some F are definitely G, but no information given about the remaining part, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

169 : 12 :: 81 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: √1st number - 1 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 169 : 12

⇒ √169 - 1

⇒ 13 - 1 = 12.

Similarly, for **81 : ?**

⇒ **√81 - 1**

**⇒ 9 - 1 = 8.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
